status_at_freeze: Catalogue availability and metadata inspected; no target catalogue rows or matching outcomes inspected.
sample: Exactly the existing 265 unique DES C3/X3 selected eight-band hosts with valid three-band SPIRE map measurements and >=64 common sky offsets; unchanged original cuts.
acquisition: Official IRSA TAP, all native columns inside the union of 75 arcsec spherical cones around selected hosts; deduplicate exact table+cntr, retain all raw rows and flags. Query batches of 20 hosts. Full native metadata and primary documentation retained.
association: Exact spherical separation; report every candidate within 6 arcsec and nearest candidate up to 75 arcsec; 1, 2, 3 and 6 arcsec radius sensitivity. Primary radius 1 arcsec for IRAC-positioned SWIRE/SERVS, 2 arcsec for separate MIPS24. Require unique IR candidate within primary radius and no other unflagged DES deep galaxy within primary radius of the IR centroid. Flag whether target is nearest optical galaxy. Preserve unmatched/ambiguous hosts. This is a conservative geometry screen, not a posterior association probability.
photometry: Preserve all native columns and IDs. Summary uses native aperture2 with error, flux in microJy, and native coverage/extension/blending flags. Never substitute -99 sentinels, absent rows or catalogue non-detections with zero or upper limits. Extended-source aperture caution remains. No dust luminosity, age correction or cosmological fit.
independence: SWIRE and SERVS partly share Spitzer photons and instrument calibration; overlapping catalogue entries are not independent observations. Bandmerged SWIRE24 and separate24 can be the same detection via detid_24.
controls: Root independently owns matching_controls.py; candidate acquisition radius supports shifts <=60 arcsec plus <=6 arcsec matching, with coverage/completeness caveats.
selection: Detection-selected public catalogues, not forced photometry at every host; no-match does not prove covered non-detection. Optical competitor catalogue excludes flagged/non-galaxy classified entries and is not complete for possible IR emitters.
timestamp_basis: Original design-file filesystem modification time, before target matching outcomes.
